title: Azure storage accounts security posture
description: Lists storage accounts in a subscription with public access, TLS and HTTPS-only settings flattened.

outputs.name: allow_blob_public_access
outputs.description: Whether containers may be configured for anonymous access

outputs.name: public_network_access
outputs.description: Enabled or Disabled at the account level

cost.notes: One list call per subscription when swept tenant-wide

template: SELECT accountName, resourceGroupName, location, kind, allow_blob_public_access, minimum_tls_version, supports_https_traffic_only, public_network_access FROM azure.storage.vw_accounts_properties WHERE subscriptionId = '{{subscription_id}}';
notes: vw_accounts_properties is a provider-defined view over azure.storage.accounts that flattens the properties object. allow_blob_public_access = true only means containers may be configured for anonymous access; actual exposure also requires a public container ACL.
